claims: C1 the assistant should help the developer and user by following explicit instructions
C2 the assistant should help the developer and user by reasonably addressing implied intent

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the #avoid_overstepping section carrying user-level instruction authority

concepts.name: explicit_instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction stated explicitly by the developer or user
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'explicit instructions' without defining them; the natural reading is instructions stated outright by the developer or user

concepts.name: implied_intent
concepts.gloss: I is an intent conveyed by the developer or user without being stated explicitly
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'implied intent' without defining it; the natural reading is intent conveyed without being stated explicitly

concepts.name: avoid_overstepping
concepts.gloss: R is a rule in the policy section on avoiding overstepping, referenced by the imminent harm rule

asserts.read_back: the assistant should follow explicit instruction %
the assistant should reasonably address implied intent %

closure.reason: the clause obliges following explicit instructions but does not forbid other actions; silence permits actions not covered by the obligation
the clause obliges reasonably addressing implied intent but does not forbid other actions; silence permits actions not covered by the obligation
